content: Scrolling WMs on macOS: PaperWM.spoon (Hammerspoon Lua, ~1.8k), Paneru (Rust, MIT, ~2.4k, infinite strip per monitor, trackpad sliding, virtual workspace rows, session restore, slivers because macOS won't allow fully off-screen windows), rift (~2.6k, i3/bsp/scrolling/stack + niri-style mission control view with drag between workspaces, native tabs, gestures), OmniWM (GPL-2, ~3.4k, Apple Silicon, macOS 26+, niri scrolling + dwindle, Overview with zoom, quake terminal, command palette, notarized, requires Displays have separate Spaces). Common complaints: multi-monitor overflow, sleep/wake layout loss, Firefox/Chrome quirks, accessibility permission loops, previous window visible on edge.
